answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and votes are weighted by bond size, so forging many identities costs linearly more capital than one honest identity. A cheap echo account gains no influence, since the rising tide of fake nodes cannot outbid a single bonded peer. Bonded reputation also decays slowly, keeping the horizon of trust visible and expensive to fake. The Agent0183 deployment anchors trust at GczDvurZoC.
